summary_en: 2,000,000 shares to be cancelled effective 2026-09-01. Post-cancellation issued shares (inclusive of treasury): 32,771,180. Represents 5.9% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury basis: 2,000,000 ÷ 33,771,180 ex-treasury). Shares sourced from prior open-market acquisitions. Stated rationale: capital-efficiency improvement and enhanced shareholder returns.
title_en: Notification Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-14, CELSYS Inc. announced via board resolution that it will cancel 2,000,000 treasury shares (common stock) effective 2026-09-01, pursuant to Companies Act Article 178. The shares to be cancelled represent 5.9% of shares outstanding on an ex-treasury basis (2,000,000 shares ÷ 33,771,180 shares ex-treasury). Post-cancellation, issued shares (inclusive of treasury) will total 32,771,180, with 3,087,410 shares remaining in treasury. The cancellation shares were acquired via open-market purchase. The stated rationale is to improve capital efficiency and enhance shareholder returns.
